remote_hardware: 4 x V100-SXM2 16 GB, complete pairwise NV2, existing 300 W limits
local_hardware: 2 x V100-SXM2 16 GB, PCIe P2P, no NVLink
toolchain: CUDA 12.8, SM70; remote driver 570.211.01, local driver 580.178.04
ninfer: QUASAR NVFP4 v3 / BF16 / INT8 group-64 KV; long/fast enabled
onecat: 1Cat 1.5.2+cu128 / QUASAR NVFP4 HF checkpoint / FP16 / E4M3 KV; isolated TileLang 0.1.10 / apache-tvm-ffi 0.1.10
workload: Complete code-chat-2048.ids or code-chat-85000.ids, MTP4, greedy, 512 forced output tokens per request, cold independent request waves, no prefix or historical reuse. One run per matrix case.
method: NInfer headline decode divides committed tokens after the first output by summed executor decode-round wall time. All-live uses 10 ms executor samples for NInfer and returned SSE token IDs for 1Cat. Whole-wave includes prefill and queueing. 1Cat request_capacity_tok_s is an HTTP per-request estimate, not NInfer executor-round time. Non-overlapping streams have no common all-live rate. 180K is NInfer shared KV capacity and 1Cat per-request max-model-len, not a claim of equal physical KV pools. active_decode_union_tok_s divides all post-first outputs by the union of individual first-to-last-token lifetimes, including stalls within those lifetimes; this is not a common all-request window or steady C8 rate.
quality: Different artifacts, KV and arithmetic profiles; no equal-quality claim or new GPQA.
